note: Created once in Admin (Settings > Custom data > Products) or via metafieldDefinitionCreate. If a reviews app (Judge.me / Loox / Yotpo) is installed later, drop rating_value/review_count and point pl-product-card.liquid at that app's own metafield namespace instead — it already ships rating + count as product metafields, so no markup change is needed, only the two lines in pl-product-card.liquid that read the metafield.

metafieldDefinitions.name: Badge label
metafieldDefinitions.description: Overlay pill text on the shop grid card, e.g. 'Best seller', 'New', 'Top rated'. Independent of inventory status — Sold out is derived automatically from availability and always takes priority over this.

metafieldDefinitions.name: Rating value
metafieldDefinitions.description: e.g. 4.8. Fallback used only if no reviews-app rating metafield is present.

metafieldDefinitions.name: Review count
metafieldDefinitions.description: e.g. 237. Fallback used only if no reviews-app metafield is present.
